description: English and Arabic queries cover broad country terms, all four January weekly windows, issue terms, local outlets, regional/sector/diaspora searches, rights/international sources, migrant actions, and a focused PFG follow-up. Search calls return pooled results without totals or per-query URL attribution; this remains a non-exhaustive open-web pass, not LexisNexis-equivalent coverage.
required_followup: Continue any source review or official-baseline search; the web pass is bounded and does not establish absence.

description: The Sabha electricity workers’ union protest, Tripoli teachers’ sit-in, Tax Authority sit-in, and Jan5 Hariga protest stand have no source-supported concurrent attendance estimate of 50 or more. Workforce size, force strength, unpaid membership, duration and images are not crowd counts.
required_followup: Search contemporary local and union sources for same-time attendance counts and confirm each crowd separately; do not infer from workforce size or sit-in duration.

description: Exact physical onset/end of the teachers’ and Tax Authority sit-ins remains unresolved; Jan5 Hariga protest-stand end/location is uncertain. The Jan24–Feb11 Hariga account describes a work sit-in/strike and port closure but does not place a public crowd; it is excluded as a physical public-gathering event. State-response variables for January event candidates remain unknown unless directly evidenced.
required_followup: Clarify exact physical gathering end/location and any documented direct state response; do not treat port reopening or meetings with commanders as automatic official reception.

description: Accounts of the Tax Authority sit-in differ in their description of the wage issue and requests: Al-Ain reports opposition to a 20% salary cut; Sada attributes a 20% deduction decision and health-insurance demand to the Authority; LANA reports a salary-parity/raise request to the Ministry of Finance. The 18th-day (Jan27) and 22nd-day (Jan31) reports are consistent with a January start but do not state an exact start date. No account gives a participant count.
required_followup: Search the employee/authority statement and other local contemporaneous reports for the exact start, participants, common demands, locations, and response; preserve each attribution and leave day-level onset unknown absent direct evidence.

description: Houn protestors publicly gathered at a Haftar-affiliated military facility on Dec31. A Jan6 article reports a four-day civil-disobedience action that ended after a meeting and promises from a Haftar-affiliated military delegation, but does not provide exact onset/end days or evidence of a separate January gathering. No attendance count is available. The factional delegation's promise is not treated as official state accommodation or completed fulfillment.
required_followup: Seek dated local accounts for any separate January assembly, exact civil-disobedience dates, and whether a recognized domestic government body received or acted on the demands; maintain December ownership absent a January-start event.

description: A state news-agency report dates pensioner syndicate gathering outside the GNA headquarters to Feb1 and gives no evidence of a January onset. This is currently a forward-discovery lead for February, not a January continuation.
required_followup: Check the February unit for any new reports that this pensioners' protest continued or was preceded by a January assembly; do not move ownership without such evidence.

description: A diaspora-specific query returned a LANA report of Libyan communities protesting in Berlin on 2025-06-20, outside this unit month. No Jan2021 diaspora action was identified; the one-query search cannot establish absence.
required_followup: Search additional dated English/Arabic diaspora terms and locations if expanding this non-exhaustive pass; preserve any foreign-location action as outside domestic Libya coding.

description: The Jan5 Alwasat photo caption identifies a Hariga Brigade protest stand, while contemporaneous Libya Observer reports describe an armed export blockade over the same pay issue; whether they are one physical episode remains unresolved. Akhbar Libya24 search metadata is a related lead, but its page was inaccessible (HTTP 403) and provides no usable field evidence. A later Alwasat photo caption does not establish attendance, exact venue or duration. The Jan24–Feb11 Hariga account describes an on-the-job work sit-in/strike and port closure but does not place a public crowd; it is excluded as a physical public-gathering event. State-response variables for January candidates remain unknown absent direct evidence.
required_followup: Review whether the Jan5 captioned protest stand establishes a qualifying public gathering; keep it pending threshold/episode review. Treat the Jan24–Feb11 action as a work stoppage/armed blockade unless evidence places a public crowd; do not infer 50+ from personnel strength.

description: The Sabha electricity-workers reports name the General Electricity Company of Libya (GECOL) in connection with salary arrears, but the opened passages do not establish its ownership/status as a domestic state actor. E001 therefore remains pending state-target review as well as the crowd threshold.
required_followup: Find a source that explicitly establishes GECOL ownership/status or otherwise attributes the salary demand to a domestic state actor; preserve the current source attribution and do not infer state status from the company name.
